test_scene: A Gulf Arab merchant in a white thobe and ghutra standing at a small souq stall, holding a single coin in his open palm, a wooden dhow on the sea behind him.

styles.desc: طبقات كثيرة من الورق المقوّى بعمق حقيقي وظلال بين الطبقات. الأسلوب الأساسي للنظام.
styles.prompt: Deep layered paper-cut shadowbox diorama: dozens of stacked hand-cut cardstock layers with clear physical gaps and soft shadows between them, visible cut edges and paper thickness.

styles.desc: قصاصات مسطحة بحواف ممزقة ومقصوصة، وملمس ورق قديم ومطبوعات. قريب من أسلوب الشرح التحريري.
styles.prompt: Flat editorial cut-paper collage: overlapping flat paper cut-outs with scissor-cut and torn edges, vintage printed paper and halftone textures, shallow depth, thin drop shadows, shot straight-on like a collage on a table of paper.

styles.desc: أشكال هندسية من ورق مطوي بطيّات حادة وأسطح مضلّعة.
styles.prompt: Origami world: every figure and object is folded from single sheets of paper with crisp creases, flat faceted planes and sharp geometric folds, no curves, visible fold lines.

styles.desc: ظلال ورقية داكنة مقصوصة أمام خلفيات مضيئة من الخلف. درامي ومناسب للشخصيات التي لا تُصوَّر ملامحها.
styles.prompt: Backlit paper shadow theatre: dark cut-paper silhouettes with no facial features, arranged in receding layers in front of warm glowing translucent paper backdrops, strong rim light, deep atmospheric layering.

styles.desc: كرتون مموّج وورق كرافت بني بحواف خشنة ظاهرة. يدوي وخام.
styles.prompt: Handmade corrugated cardboard and brown kraft paper world: visible corrugated flute edges, rough hand-cut contours, layered cardboard relief, limited earthy palette with a few colored paper accents.

styles.desc: شرائط ورق ملفوفة ومثنية على حافتها ترسم الأشكال. زخرفي ومناسب للعمارة والنقوش.
styles.prompt: Paper quilling artwork: shapes drawn with thin paper strips standing on edge, coiled, curled and looped, filling forms with tight spirals, on a flat paper base, seen slightly from above with fine shadows from every strip.

people_rule: All people are flat-layered cut-paper figures: faces and hands are built from a few flat cardstock shapes with hard scissor-cut edges and visible layer steps, simple cut-out features, matte paper only. No smooth shading, no rounded 3D volume, no glossy eyes, no cartoon grin, no clay, no Pixar or toy look.
